## Checklist

- [ ] `just gate` is green
- [ ] Behaviour change comes with a fixture under `evalbench/fixtures/` or a unit test
- [ ] Bug fix comes with a test that fails before the change
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (stdlib only)
- [ ] Version not bumped (releases are cut by the maintainer)
